about: Our English one-liners for the 124 video-shotcraft shot cards (the cards are in Chinese: studio/toolkit/video-shotcraft/references/shots/<category>/<name>.md, Apache-2.0, Vincentwei1021). Written by the studio 2026-10-24 so search works in English for every model.

cards.basic-3d-scene: impress.js-style space: cards scattered in 3D at different positions, rotations and scales; the camera flies to each step's inverse pose, then pulls back to an overview
cards.crash-zoom-punch: a 6-frame crash zoom from wide to the target close-up; land with an overshoot-and-settle (elastic) or a hard stop with screen shake (weight)
cards.cursor-flyover: overhead of the whole page, then the camera flies to four feature areas; an SVG cursor arrives first, clicks with a ripple that triggers the UI, then back to overhead
cards.depth-layer-moves: layered depth dolly: three layers at graded speeds slide sideways to build depth; the hero lifts as the slide settles
cards.graze-face-tour: steep-angle low fly-over grazing the UI surface (sidebar, top bar, list as terrain); page text floats above with matching soft shadows and drops into place as the camera passes
cards.overhead-camera-moves: two overhead reveals: tilt-reveal (tilt up to level) and tabletop-drop (slide across a table of cards, then plunge into one)
cards.space-camera-moves: two spatial moves: exploded-view (parts fly apart along Z and reassemble) and drone-dive-landing
cards.steep-tilt-glide: fixed camera, the page stands at a 60° perspective and slides past along its own 3D plane with speed ghosting; widgets drop from mid-air while it goes dark to light
cards.tension-camera-moves: emotional camera: bullet-time freeze-orbit and pull-back isolation; the camera feels for the viewer
cards.terminal-3d: three terminals in 3D space; the camera flies between them (sine pull-back in transit), each types a command and its result lines slide out
cards.before-after-slider-scrub: before/after wipe bar: the divider flicks fast then sweeps slowly, developing the new version where it passes
cards.chart-live-moves: living charts: oscilloscope stream with spikes, a dot swarm regrouping into a number, and an axis that rescales when a value bursts out of frame
cards.gauge-readout-moves: gauges: needle self-test sweep to full arc then back to the true value, and a fixed pointer over a scrolling tape with a braking sprint
cards.scroll-brake-moves: long-scroll hard brake: high-speed changelog scroll with exponential deceleration to an exact stop and the target lifting; optional reticle lock on the brake frame
cards.timeline-travel: camera accelerates along a horizontal version timeline, a card pops up at each tick, hard stop and push-in at the last
cards.assemble-then-type-flyin: on an empty dark grid, text-less component skeletons fly in from every side, then every letter spins in from 3D space (headline first, labels last) until the page is complete
cards.aurora-bloom-bg-flip: soft purple-orange blobs rise on light grey, then the whole ground darkens to near-black in ~0.36 s; copy blurs out and back in with a gap, never a cross-fade
cards.brand-frame-snap: a thick brand-colour frame grows around the screen before the content; a screen recording drops inside; mode changes flip the frame colour and layout on the same frame
cards.fui-hud-moves: FUI reticle lock-on: four L-shaped corner marks fly in, overshoot and clamp onto the target
cards.glow-flyline-moves: dark-field glow orbs as ambient noise, arcing fly-lines connecting points, and both pulsing on the same frame
cards.icon-performance-moves: attention bounce: an icon jumps higher each time, squashes on landing and pulls the camera toward it
cards.impact-feedback: hit feedback: hit-stop with damage numbers and combo counter, and an anime impact frame (negative, speed lines, chromatic split)
cards.light-play-moves: light as a brush: spotlight sweep that lights a dark title where it passes, and a single sheen across a dark hero card (dark grounds only, ≤ 2 light effects per film)
cards.radial-ripple-phone-chips: four concentric circles breathe out of phase like water on warm sand; a phone mock-up scrolls its feed while white chips spring in on both sides and float
cards.riso-print-hits: risograph misregistration hit: the title slams, splits into two ink plates, shakes twice and snaps into register
cards.scan-bracket-sweep: a document pops to centre, L-brackets drop on its corners, and a scan band with a gradient tail sweeps it five times; only the light moves
cards.scanline-annotate-focus: a scan line descends over the page; each block it passes gets corner brackets springing onto it, then a typed machine label, with a 00/06 → 06/06 status counter
cards.scanline-assemble-flyin: a blueprint board of grid and dashed slots; a bright scan line descends and each slot's component flies in with directional smear and a snap mark; the page is assembled when the scan ends
cards.slam-entrance-moves: high-energy slams: Kanada perspective snap, score slam, and an impact burst that shakes neighbouring cards
cards.spotlight-sweep-moves: dark-field spotlight reveals: lit only while the light passes, purple edge-bleed pan, and a corner-out radial reveal of the whole screen
cards.autolayout-gap-dial: a row of link blocks with selection outline and gap annotation; the gap number ticks up and the blocks are pushed apart live, then spring back
cards.canvas-materialize-moves: content materialises onto a canvas: table rows arc out of a panel and become canvas cards, and a typed prompt grows a node tree layer by layer (links before nodes)
cards.chip-grid-single-select-blackout: five option chips fade in 3+2; on select, one grey press frame, then the chip turns ink-black with a 1→1.04→1 bounce while the rest fade to 18 %; a price rises below
cards.collab-cursor-moves: collaborator cursors as a cast: five named cursors fly in staggered, drift, type a cameo and gather to watch
cards.glass-pill-dictation-typing: a glass pill pops in at 1.25× and settles, warm accent light fills it, the cursor leads and a dictated sentence types out while the light fades to neutral frosted glass
cards.hashtag-to-pill-materialize: typed '#word' with a solid cursor hard-cuts in one frame into a wide pill tag, which shrinks and slides into its slot, then a hard cut reveals the finished page
cards.picker-carousel-feature-cycle: mobile picker wheel: the focus pill stays still, items pass through with outQuint snap, opacity/size/grey by distance, the pill breathes on each landing
cards.segmented-thumb-hero: a giant segmented control springs in, a cursor presses, the white thumb slides in 8 frames and the new icon springs out as the old one tucks away
cards.theme-switch-moves: theme switch: a diagonal sweep re-skins the page where it passes, or a ⌘K palette collapses to a dot and a ripple re-skins from it
cards.type-and-filter: typing in a real search box, the grid converges to one card, a click goes through to its detail page
cards.voice-waveform-live: a recording pill with 64 bars reacting to speech, flat dots in pauses, scrolling right to left; speak → pause → speak → submit collapses it
cards.brand-ink-open: ink crosshair is drawn, the wordmark stamps letter by letter, a typewriter subtitle, one full second of stillness, then it floats away
cards.crane-rise-reveal: starts tight on one data row, the camera cranes up and back with deceleration until the whole dashboard fills the frame
cards.dataviz-landscape-open: dark-field landscape of streamlines merging into a trunk, fictional ID labels riding the lines, slow deep-focus fly-over
cards.fracture: 5×5 tiles gather from 3D shards in rings from the centre into a poster, beat, title lights, then all shards spin outward off screen
cards.icon-field-colorize: a grid of grey icons fades in to fill the screen, beat, then brand-colour bands ripple down and colour everything at once
cards.letterspace-materialize: a widely tracked wordmark draws all its letters at once, strokes growing like handwriting, finishing together into the word
cards.magician-card-flourish: a blue star-flash on midnight blue, a card shoots out spinning toward the camera, spin decays, hard freeze at 86 % frame height, light pulse and sheen, copy reveals line by line
cards.orbit-ring-title-open: eight dark 16:9 cards orbit an ellipse (depth from scale, z-order and dimming only), they start playing together; a two-level title deblurs into place and a highlighter block sweeps the keyword
cards.spotlight-hero-card: a tungsten spotlight with a volumetric beam sweeps a dark page and locks on one card, which lifts while a champagne light traces its outline twice, then settles back
cards.stroke-segment-build: the title is broken into a dozen disconnected strokes lit in random order; unreadable for 70 %, the last stroke makes it click
cards.text-as-mask: giant bold letters cut from a porcelain stage show a live product panel inside; at the end the type zooms 46× and the footage takes the screen
cards.grain-dissolve: a line of text bursts into boiling grain inside a selection marquee, the cloud condenses into a bigger glowing short wordmark and settles
cards.logo-shrink-wordmark-lockup: a big neon ring contracts to a small solid dot, swaps to the logo at the overshoot, slides left and the wordmark letters slide in to lock up, tagline last
cards.neon-triple-marquee: three rows of hollow neon words on an angled brick wall scroll in opposite directions, lighting in thirds, then switch off row by row
cards.outro-group-photo-launch: every element of the film flies in to surround the wordmark for a group photo; crane down, stage light and gold dust — a launch-event ending
cards.ui-strip-away-outro: subtractive ending: after clicking Publish the whole editor evaporates from the edges inward, only the button remains, centres, grows and hands over to the wordmark
cards.ui-to-brand-morph: UI becomes the brand: an icon flips flat into a line that opens into the logo, or an input box shrinks into a frame stroke and parts drop into place to build the logo
cards.beat-cut-moves: hard cuts as a drum: three white flashes, each cutting to a tighter crop of the same picture (wide → card → detail), settling on the detail
cards.beat-step-list-theme-cycle: three channels on one beat: a word list steps up a row, a fixed centre pill catches the next word and changes colour, and the whole ground changes colour
cards.panel-grid-moves: comic panel split: diagonal panels show three angles of the same subject, click-click-click, then the last panel's edge eats the screen into a poster
cards.quad-split-parallel-scenes: hard cut to a 2×2 grid running four micro-scenes in parallel (typing, push-in, word-by-word, interaction), key beats offset 3–6 frames
cards.rhythm-interrupt-moves: jump-cut punch-in: three un-tweened hard jumps of the same framing, each closer to the target
cards.sakuga-timing-shift: moves on threes like a flip book, then switches to smooth ones for the climax sprint; the frame-rate change is the show
cards.speed-ramp-freeze: non-linear frame remap: flow → freeze with a circled annotation → unfreeze
cards.trailer-grammar-moves: trailer bumper: three 9-frame quick cuts, one beat of black silence, then the opening title
cards.bottom-push-stack-wipe: chapter change by pushing the new scene with its saturated ground up from the bottom, physically shoving the old one off; content pinned to its own ground
cards.card-flip-reveal: feature cards flip 180° on Y, a light glints across the thin edge, the back shows a big result number; staggered along the row
cards.card-flock-tumble: three UI page cards tumble in from their edges into a staircase, keep turning slowly, collapse into the centre and burst into one turbulent smoke ring; giant type closes
cards.circle-match-iris: iris cut from the centre of a round element; the new page's round chart sits on the same circle — a match cut with a meaning
cards.gradient-transition: background morphs between linear, radial and conic CSS gradients, interpolating angles, stops, centre and radius
cards.line-carry-transition: a progress bar in scene A extends off frame, the camera follows it, and the line turns corners to draw scene B's card frame; no cut
cards.mosaic-reframe: twelve tiles morph between a regular grid, a feature mosaic and a diagonal cascade, each interpolating position and size with a slight stagger
cards.page-turn-transitions: barn-door split: the old page splits in two and slides out while the new page comes forward
cards.print-texture-transitions: ink-bleed reveal: a feathered ink stain spreads and eats the old scene
cards.shot-transitions: three shot hand-offs chosen by energy gap and seam meaning: push-through to white, whip pan with a hard brake, mask wipe through a window
cards.tear-streak-transitions: glitch displace: 16 horizontal strips jitter apart and the cut happens inside the tear
cards.transition-hidden-cut: hidden cuts: foreground occlusion, collision opening, warm light leak — the cut hides in 1–3 frames of cover
cards.transition-travel: travel through a letter: the giant chapter title's letterform is a window and the camera dives through a stroke into the next scene
cards.white-flash-logo-simplify-cut: a liquid-metal coloured wordmark shimmers, charges, bursts a white flash from its centre; as the exposure falls, the flat version sits in the same place
cards.wipe-transitions: venetian-blind wipe: twelve 3D slats flip in a staggered wave, turning page A into page B
cards.blur-slide: headline word by word: y 0.38 em → 0, blur 18 → 0, opacity 0 → 1 on one ease-out, ~4 frames apart; the subtitle starts before the headline ends
cards.brace-expand: a tiny pair of braces appears at centre, springs apart with overshoot to headline size, and the text is revealed between them like a curtain, then the tracking relaxes
cards.countdown-arc-scatter: nine numerals on a paper dial sweep 96° and brake; the '5' lands as the title's first character while the others blur away, the title fades in word by word
cards.document-typewriter-reveal: a typeset document window writes itself behind the cursor in a dark field, sidebar follows, history items drop in, camera pulls back from a side close-up to the full window
cards.flying-words: 22 keywords on a golden-angle ellipse fly from far away past the camera along Z with a life curve, two seamless loops
cards.glitch-cycle: one mono slot cycles four status phrases, each scrambling at its ends with RGB split and line shift at each switch; the last one ends clean
cards.gradient-word-sweep: a gradient light charges a keyword left to right on black, glow strongest at the wavefront, then thin lightning links the letters and the word breathes
cards.lead-word-zoom-assemble: the first word fills the centre at 2.3× and keeps pushing in, then one curve shrinks it to size while the line slides into place and the next words are pushed in
cards.marker-underline-title: after the headline lands, a marker underline is drawn under the keyword: variable width, rough edge, slight upward slant
cards.outline-word-fill: an outlined word shrinks from 3.2× into place, a dashed circle closes around it and turns, then the solid white-hot word cuts on in one frame with a single glow
cards.paper-title-card: one sentence stamped word by word onto paper, one word in an accent-colour italic, a dash to close
cards.pill-chip-slot-cycle-handled: 'Your [chip] Handled': the word inside a dark pill rolls vertically, the pill width interpolates to the measured text and pushes the neighbours, ghost items peek at 13 %
cards.pill-slot-cycle: a fixed sentence with a slot-machine pill at the end that rolls every ~0.7 s, then lands on the final full sentence
cards.text-column-converge: 'NEW' on the left and a feature word on the right swap by hard cuts at fixed margins; only on the last word do they slide together into one phrase
cards.title-demote-to-label: a big title holds, then shrinks to 0.3× and moves to the top-left as a section label while the content grows below (optionally with a text-selection highlight)
cards.type-assembly-moves: text assembly: split-text stagger rise, letterforms drifting together, and text flowing along a path
cards.type-entrance-moves: letter-drop physics: characters fall with gravity, bounce, land crooked and straighten together on the last beat
cards.type-rhythm-sync: type synced to sound: font-weight pump on the drum and karaoke fill word by word with the narration
cards.typewriter-moves: typewriter error-retype: types a bland word, hesitates, backspaces, then types the selling word faster
cards.vertical-word-roll-blur-cycle: the last word rolls vertically three times (0.55 s each, fast then very slow with a small overshoot); neighbours blurred and grey, the landed word colours in
cards.word-relay-filmstrip: left column of page cards steps like a film strip (focus card lit, neighbours dimmed), right side a big serif word relays (noun fixed, verb changing), aligned to the current card
cards.word-relay-geometry: three benefit words each with their own geometry hand-off: rotating dashed circle with a comet, three circles trimming in and closing, a chrome sheen that resolves to white
cards.avatar-bracket-carousel: 'Your ___ agent': fixed focus brackets in the sentence, avatars spring through the bracket three times (sharp inside, blurred outside), role label changes, brackets breathe 7 %
cards.bezier-source-converge-merge: four source nodes on the left draw Bézier curves to one merge point, slide along them, shrink and vanish while an accent data packet travels; the curves erase leaving the logo
cards.card-stack: template cards spring up from below one by one, faster each time, into a pile; then the pile fans out (6.5° and 138 px per card) and the centre card is pulled out
cards.carousel-3d: eight cards on a ring turn one revolution (steady with a stop every 45°), always upright and facing out; the front card lights up and the caption below changes
cards.cloner-depth-echo: the main card instantly copies itself into seven translucent clones in a diagonal line, beat, then they all accelerate back into one with a bounce
cards.deck-deal-flyin: close orbit around a real card deck on dark graphite, light moves to the page board, the deck is dealt into the grid with hard acceleration, the camera rises to a runway overhead
cards.doc-park-left-pill-deal: the document slides left to 35 % width and scales to 0.92 (still scrolling slowly), three outlined pills are dealt in on the narration's rhythm with their captions
cards.draw-svg-trace: an ink line with a pen tip runs once around an element's outline to draw it, flashes on closing, content fades in; same trick underlines a title
cards.element-body-moves: contact-shadow lift: as a card rises its shadow on the table grows and softens, proving it left the surface
cards.integration-hub-map: the old page flips 180° in one fast move into a hub; five integration icons pop on the same frame, five rainbow light-pipes connect and pulses keep flowing
cards.list-reveal: a six-item vertical menu scales in item by item every 10 frames with a soft back overshoot while the whole list drifts up at constant speed — two unrelated motions
cards.list-stack-press: list cards fly up from the bottom and stack; each landing compresses the pile and a counter ticks
cards.neon-frame-forerun: a perspective neon frame draws itself from the left edge, the page brightens inside it while widgets drop from above with soft shadows; background neon echoes switch off
cards.neon-frame-orbit-drop: after the neon frame is drawn the camera arcs left to right around the page and every widget drops into place on the same frame
cards.page-waterfall-wall: real page screenshots cut into 3–4 columns on a tilted 3D wall scroll in opposite directions forever with a slow push-in — 'endless content'
cards.product-card-progressive-assemble: a detail card builds itself field by field behind a fill cursor: image, title, tag, old price struck through and the new price springs in, body lines, swatches, button fills
cards.radial-wave: a 17×9 dot grid lights in order of distance from a source, each dot overshooting to 1.5×, then a second blue pulse returns from the edge to the centre
cards.research-card-stack-scroll: dark paper cards fly in every 12 frames and stack with a 1-frame squash; only the top card is sharp, lower ones blur and darken by depth, the grid moves for speed reference
cards.row-embed: a content row descends like a card, rotateX flattens it, and an accent seam lights along its bottom edge as it embeds
cards.value-stagger-gradient: sixteen bars: the delay staggers in time while height, hue, offset and blur each form a gradient from first to last; then the stagger origin moves to the centre
cards.wall-reveal-moves: whole wall reveals in place: bento cells light one by one, or a blueprint line drawing becomes the page (no movement, the opposite of deck-deal)
